name: trading-agent-mpu-gandring
changelog: Partial closes preserve remaining exposure; cumulative fills and restart ownership are reconciled without duplicate orders
Protective orders are preserved while exposure remains; settled entries can reconcile subsequent exchange-side exits
Execution sizing uses venue quotes and active stop/TP configuration; account and PnL displays identify their evidence source
Auto OFF stops queued symbols, Lead receives strategy invalidation, and HOLD/CLOSE skip unused Risk model calls
Opportunity ordering uses available momentum, trend and volume evidence; inferred trade-flow metrics no longer claim wallet tracking
Six-agent office gains event-driven activities, role routines, furniture-aware paths, compact speech and reduced-motion handling
Visual acceptance, advanced interactions, missed-opportunity tracking and actual fee/funding history remain follow-up work
description: Trading Agent Mpu Gandring: a desk of AI trading agents that argue, debate and (cartoon) fight over every trade, then pass a risk gate. Paper by default; full auto on testnet or live after a one-time setup, behind automatic guards. Comes with a cozy virtual office UI.
author: Abrur Alaina
